note: SOST is now exclusively a blockchain project. The scientific code trees (scripts/trinity, scripts/useful_compute, tests/trinity, schemas/trinity, config/trinity, data/trinity, the TRINITY_* artefacts and their docs) are removed from HEAD and preserved in the git tag trinity-final-archive.
